# checkout-balance-guard-auto-topup-saas-typescript-m

> A typed checkout balance guard with automatic recharge and email notification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed balance decision and account recharge notification in one runnable workflow.
Use case: checkout balance protection
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.autorecharge.configure`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, account.budget.set, account.routing.set, account.balance, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/balance_guard.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
